{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tapani language''' was the [[Language/Legends|dialect]] spoken in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic disk]]. Certain Tapani [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] became servants of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], a sect of powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|darksiders]] headquartered in the [[Stygian Caldera]], which made their language one of the dialects spoken by the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] under Sith rule.<ref name="Secrets">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets]]''</ref> Examples of spoken Tapani were the names of [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in the [[Tapani calendar]].<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
